ModMetaData.name: DMSE 导弹阵地穿梭机与重组远行队修复 / DMSE Missile Base Shuttle & Reform Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复 DMSE 敌方导弹/防空阵地的两类站点交互问题：
1. 仅将 DMSE_MissileBase、DMSE_FieldLaunchSite、DMSE_EarlyLaunchSite 的 validLaunchTarget 修正为 true，恢复穿梭机/运输舱进入，同时保留射程、燃料、BVR 防空风险确认、实际防空和撤退重入冷却。 2. 修复清场后无法重组远行队及导弹战利品遗漏：为这三类 Site 采用临时营地式迷雾威胁规则；让真正无弹的炮塔不再永久阻塞；让安全的 CompMissileRackStorage 库存通过真实落地流程进入远行队和穿梭机装载。
不会把仍有电且武装的炮塔当作安全目标，也不会远程清空活跃防空系统。Wing-Back 出生时其实有 300 个绝对燃料单位，可正常开火；本补丁处理的是实际耗尽后的状态。
不修改工坊原件，不写自定义存档字段，可安全增删。
Standalone DMSE site-interaction fix: 1. Enables shuttle/pod entry only on the three enemy missile-base WorldObjectDefs while preserving fuel/range checks, BVR interception prompts, live air defense, and post-retreat re-entry cooldowns. 2. Fixes fogged/dry-defense reform deadlocks and makes safe CompMissileRackStorage contents genuinely collectible through vanilla ground-loot, caravan, and transporter paths.
Armed powered turrets and operational air defense remain protected. No Workshop edits, no custom save fields, safe to add or remove.
